title: Shane Steichen: Gonna be really fun watching Keenan Allen with Daniel Jones

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shane Steichen: Gonna be really fun watching Keenan Allen with Daniel Jones
sources.description: Wide receiver Keenan Allen wasn't on the field for the Colts' joint practice with the Falcons on Wednesday, but thoughts of what he'll look like in the offense were on head coach Shane Steichen's mind.
